earlier_issues: all 140 images rejected as blank (P21: multichannel uint16 normalisation)
now: STILL 0 images (state 'empty', blank_or_tiny 140/140). Root cause is not the per-channel normalisation but read_image: PIL opens the 16-bit 4-sample (RGBA-like) TIFF without error as mode RGBA, silently truncated to 8-bit (np.array max 15), so the tifffile fallback in read_image never runs and informative() rejects the near-black result. tifffile.imread gives (1040,1392,4) uint16 and to_pil() of that gives a proper image (mean 130/64/64, informative True): real 4-channel (brightfield + fluorescence reporter) cell image
findings: Reproduction: download Dataset_Zenodo/tiff_files/A_1_0.tiff (zenodo 19500864, 11.6 MB, remotezip); PIL.Image.open(p).mode == 'RGBA'; np.array(im).max() == 15 while tifffile.imread(p).max() == 4095. Fix in prepare.read_image: for .tif/.tiff (or when im.mode in ('RGBA','RGB','LA','CMYK') and the TIFF BitsPerSample tag (258) > 8) use tifffile.imread + to_pil first. label_files/ masks are correctly not sampled.
